data_family_definitions.klines_1h: Perpetual contract OHLCV, taker volume and trade counts
data_family_definitions.mark_price_1h: Independent Mark Price series from S3 (1s sampling)
data_family_definitions.index_price_1h: Independent Spot Index Price series from S3 (1s sampling)
data_family_definitions.premium_index_1h: Official Binance Premium Index series (dampened EMA basis rate)
data_family_definitions.funding_rate: Monthly billing-level funding settlement records (calc_time, funding_interval_hours, last_funding_rate)
data_family_definitions.metrics_5m: 5-minute aggregated Open Interest value in USDT and Long/Short trader ratios
data_family_definitions.book_depth: Static visible depth ladder (+-1% to +-5% depth & notional)
data_family_definitions.agg_trades: Tick-by-tick aggregated executed trades with taker side flag (is_buyer_maker)
data_family_definitions.matched_controls: Non-delisted altcoin perpetual contracts fulfilling 168-hour baseline volatility and quote volume matching

matching_criteria.selection_rule: Order by distance ascending, then canonical symbol alphabetical; pick top 1 to 3 equal weight; if 0 satisfy, status is unmatched
